changelog:
**Expanded support for Chinese references and improved verification workflow.**

- Added explicit support for verifying both English and Chinese manuscript references, including diverse source types (journals, books, dissertations, standards, etc.).
- Integrated Chinese-title-first verification routes for Chinese sources (CNKI, Wanfang, VIP, official sites); DOI is now optional and not required for Chinese references unless citation style mandates it.
- Updated workflow and required fields to accommodate language/source-type distinctions; includes checks for ISBN, standard numbers, URLs, and official Chinese databases.
- Clarified rules for identifier handling in English vs. Chinese references, and updated match quality/status logic accordingly.
- Removed all example and template files to streamline the package.
